decisions.rationale: Operator explicitly instructed 'work without stopping for clarifying questions' at session start.

decisions.decision: Mirror Phase 55 architecture verbatim — zero-dep CJS in scripts/, exports + require.main guard, three-wave TDD, --json envelope, padded text-table default output
decisions.rationale: Sibling phase shipped clean; reuse over reinvention preserves coherence and reduces planner cognitive cost.

decisions.decision: Coverage measurement reads coverage/coverage-final.json and aggregates inside the script
decisions.rationale: Already produced by npm run test:coverage. No need to re-run tests or modify package.json scripts. Staleness threshold 3600s, exit 2 if missing/stale.

decisions.decision: Test-count measurement spawns 'node --test --test-reporter=tap' from inside the detector
decisions.rationale: Self-contained; no coupling to scripts/run-tests.cjs. ~30s wall time per detector run accepted.

decisions.decision: Hook count restricted to execution hooks (hooks/dist/*.js) for v1
decisions.rationale: Living docs use four+ different 'hook' definitions (15/16/10/7) that disagree with each other. One narrow, unambiguous metric in v1; expand once upstream definitions stabilize.

decisions.decision: Living-docs scope: exactly 3 files (CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/DEVOPS-HANDOFF.md)
decisions.rationale: DOCDRIFT-03 names these three. PROJECT.md and CHANGELOG.md are touched by /gsd:sync-docs but were intentionally not in the requirement.

decisions.decision: Three-tier exit codes (0 clean / 1 drift / 2 runtime error)
decisions.rationale: Phase 57's CI step needs to distinguish 'real drift' from 'couldn't run check'. Single-exit-1 conflates both.

decisions.decision: Drift records sorted by canonical (file, line) order — not insertion, not alphabetical
decisions.rationale: Humans scan multi-file reports in document order. Match that habit.

context_notes: Phase 56 context was gathered in auto-mode because operator opted out of clarifying questions for the session. Every gray area was auto-resolved with the recommended choice and logged in 56-DISCUSSION-LOG.md. The Phase 55 sibling (validate-doc-links.cjs) is the architectural template — same shape, same wave structure, same test harness pattern. The detector is read-only; its job is to catch numeric drift in three living docs and exit non-zero. Phase 57 wires it into CI (out of scope here). Watch for: (1) the README currently claims '65 commands' but live count is 66 — this will surface as drift in Wave 3 and needs to be fixed in the same wave; (2) c8 currently emits coverage-final.json via the existing 'json' reporter, so no .c8rc.json reporter changes needed — only an 'include' addition for the new script.
